title: Nice design that's reflective of our world, but underwhelming quality...
text: Nice design that's reflective of our world, but underwhelming quality.... Okay, so the design is very apropos for what we went through in 2020, and still going through right now. That's why we got it, for the design. But once you have it in your hands, you will be very underwhelmed. I mean this is $1 store quality. But I haven't visited any dollar stores recently, so I don't know if they would have this face mask and toilet paper design. So I guess you have to pay a premium for that aspect. 5 star design, but in terms of quality to cost ratio, I'd say it's 1 star. I would not pay $10 bucks for this. So I average out the review to 3-Stars.
